================================================================================
camlp5 tagged quotations <:tag< ... >>
================================================================================

let f x = <:expr< $x$ + 1 >>
let g = <:patt< `A x >>
let h = <:ctyp< int -> string >>
let s = <:str_item< let x = 1 >>
let m = <:module_expr< struct let a = 2 end >>
let t = <:sig_item< val y : int >>
let c = <:class_expr< object method m = 1 end >>

================================================================================
nested quotations
================================================================================

let nested = <:expr< f <:expr< 1 >> x >>
let deep = <:str_item< let q = <:ctyp< 'a >> >>

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(compilation_unit
  (value_definition
    (let_binding
      (value_name)
      (quotation
        (quotation))))
  (value_definition
    (let_binding
      (value_name)
      (quotation
        (quotation)))))

================================================================================
term quotation (backtick, non-identifier start)
================================================================================

let p = prove (`?n. n + 0 = n`, tac)
let q = ` { x | P x } `
let r = `(a, b)`

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(compilation_unit

            (term_quotation)
            (value_path
              (value_name)))))))
  (value_definition
    (let_binding
      (value_name)
      (term_quotation)))
  (value_definition
    (let_binding
      (value_name)
      (term_quotation))))

================================================================================
backtick polymorphic variants stay tags
================================================================================

let f = function `A -> 1 | `B -> 2 | `C _ -> 3
let g x = match x with `Data payload -> payload | `Empty -> 0
type t = [`A | `B of int | `c ]
let v = `Ident name

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(compilation_unit
  (value_definition
    (let_binding
      (value_name)
      (function_expression
        (match_case
          (tag)
          (number))
        (match_case
          (tag)
          (number))
        (match_case
          (tag_pattern
            (tag)
            (any_pattern))
          (number)))))
  (value_definition
    (let_binding
      (value_name)
      (parameter
        (value_pattern))
      (match_expression
        (value_path
          (value_name))
        (match_case
          (tag_pattern
            (tag)
            (value_pattern))
          (value_path
            (value_name)))
        (match_case
          (tag)
          (number)))))
  (type_definition
    (type_binding
      (type_constructor)
      (polymorphic_variant_type
        (tag_specification
          (tag))
        (tag_specification
          (tag)
          (type_constructor_path
            (type_constructor)))
        (tag_specification
          (tag)))))
  (value_definition
    (let_binding
      (value_name)
      (application_expression
        (tag)
        (value_path
          (value_name))))))

================================================================================
quotation in binding pattern and colon/dotted tag forms
================================================================================

let w = <:expr:< 1 >>
let q = <:m.n< body >>
